Enscape

Enscape provides real-time architectural visualisation and design review from connected building models.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Review the courtyard in real time

Begin with the selected model, asset hierarchy and scale. In the intended Enscape preview, review the courtyard in real time; the visible result is a composed scene with geometry and camera framing visible. Review object identity, silhouette and missing assets before accepting or exporting it.

Develop daylight and materials

Use the approved scene state, materials and motion intent. In the intended Enscape preview, develop daylight and materials; the visible result is a lighting, animation or effects preview with changed controls exposed. Review timing, material response, collisions and visual continuity before accepting or exporting it.

Prepare a stakeholder walkthrough

Start from the reviewed cameras, render settings and delivery format. In the intended Enscape preview, prepare a stakeholder walkthrough; the visible result is a bounded presentation sequence or image comparison. Review frame content, colour, legibility and output specification before accepting or exporting it.
